\section*{Question 1}

An object moving along a curve in the \(x y\)-plane has position \((x(t), y(t))\) at time \(t\) with
\[
\frac{d x}{d t}=\cos \left(t^{3}\right) \text { and } \frac{d y}{d t}=3 \sin \left(t^{2}\right)
\]
for \(0 \leq t \leq 3\). At time \(t=2\), the object is at position (4,5).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Write an equation for the line tangent to the curve at (4,5).
\item[(b)] Find the speed of the object at time \(t=2\).
\item[(c)] Find the total distance traveled by the object over the time interval \(0 \leq t \leq 1\).
\item[(d)] Find the position of the object at time \(t=3\).
\item[(a)] \(\frac{d y}{d x}=\frac{3 \sin \left(t^{2}\right)}{\cos \left(t^{3}\right)}\)
\[
\begin{aligned}
& \left.\frac{d y}{d x}\right|_{t=2}=\frac{3 \sin \left(2^{2}\right)}{\cos \left(2^{3}\right)}=15.604 \\
& y-5=15.604(x-4)
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(b)] Speed \(=\sqrt{\cos ^{2}(8)+9 \sin ^{2}(4)}=2.275\)
\item[(c)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text { Distance } & =\int_{0}^{1} \sqrt{\cos ^{2}\left(t^{3}\right)+9 \sin ^{2}\left(t^{2}\right)} d t \\
& =1.458
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(d)]
\[
\begin{aligned}
& x(3)=4+\int_{2}^{3} \cos \left(t^{3}\right) d t=3.953 \text { or } 3.954 \\
& y(3)=5+\int_{2}^{3} 3 \sin \left(t^{2}\right) d t=4.906
\end{aligned}
\]
\end{itemize}
